objects.description: [Snip3](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1086) has the ability to detect Windows Sandbox, VMWare, or VirtualBox by querying `Win32_ComputerSystem` to extract the `Manufacturer` string.(Citation: Morphisec Snip3 May 2021)
objects.description_fa: [Snip3](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1086) توانایی شناسایی Windows Sandbox، VMWare، یا VirtualBox را با جستجوی «Win32_ComputerSystem» برای استخراج رشته «Manufacturer» دارد.[[[CTI_PRESERVE_0]] (Citation: Morphisec Snip3 May 2021)
